annotations.title: Agent memory, recall: read a saved value

description: Read the value saved under a key in your namespace with /memory/set, with when it was saved and when it expires. A key that was never saved or has expired is a 404 and is not charged. Values are kept until they expire (at most 30 days) or are deleted; reads anywhere may lag a write made elsewhere by up to a minute. Use to recall what an agent saved in an earlier run. Example: namespace=demo-agent-memory-7f3c9a21, key=user-preferences. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

namespace.description: Your namespace: a secret of 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ that you choose and reuse. Anyone who knows it can read and write it, so treat it like a password; send it in a POST body to keep it out of URLs.
